name: Ritual Dagger
descriptionTemplate: When attacked by an enemy, deal 1 instance of {Fixed DMG} equal to [Arg3]% of team's Max HP. This DMG enjoys a [Arg2]% {Counter} bonus. Each enemy can trigger this effect up to 1 time per turn.
lore: A dagger with a curved blade, commonly used in sacrificial rituals.
